primary: Fresh-case answer accuracy after timed reading; this includes short-term recall.
analysis: Average questions within reader-document, readers within document, repetitions within case and writer. Bootstrap cases and readers, not questions as independent observations. Legacy randomization answer is constant and excluded from its aggregate.
ingestion: Only complete, schema-valid, explicitly submitted human JSON files in data/human/submissions; duplicate participant-item entries rejected; no test data entered.
exposure: One version per underlying case per reader; authors, old judges, old flags and answer keys withheld.
exclusions: Invalid schema, unknown assignment or duplicate participant-item entries; visibility and timeout flags reported, not silently excluded.
rewrite_arm: Pending independent human edits and fact-preservation checks; no causal style benefit claimed.
